title: State in krn-lead that a rebase does not reset the review budget
body:
Evidence: PR #148, 2026-10-31. The lead assumed a rebase onto a new main SHA resets the two-attempt review budget; `krn review` refused attempt 4 with exit 64 ("two attempts exhausted") because the series is keyed by repository + PR + baseRef (src/flow/series.ts:101; docs/program/lead-rules.md:27). The krn-lead skill says "per PR and base ref", which reads as the base SHA. Cost: one refused run and an operator question with a wrong premise.
Acceptance: the krn-lead skill states that the budget belongs to the PR and its target branch and that a rebase does not reset it; test/rules/project-skills.test.ts asserts that sentence and fails at the base.
